fact: Council of Ministers Regulation No. 585/2026, issued 11 February 2026, sets the Universal Access Fund, financed by a 1.5 per cent levy on licensees' gross revenue, to expand communications services to rural and remote unserved and underserved areas.
title: Regulation No. 585/2026: Council of Ministers Regulation for determining the amount, source and administration of Universal Access Fund
publisher: Federal Negarit Gazette of the Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia
